dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Oh hey! Wow, you actually stopped to read me—how polite!

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Welcome to GEARHAVEN ISLE. Population: me. And some robots. And sharks. Mostly me.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: Left stick moves you. R2 to run. O to dash. Right stick turns that camera you love so much.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: The town is just up the beach. People there have PROBLEMS. Problems pay CRED.

dialogue.speaker: S-1GN
dialogue.text: But you're so smart I bet you already knew that.
